slides.label: STATUS: UNCONFIRMED
slides.title:
A door back
to 2002.
slides.body: Players say GTA 6 hides a portal to the old Vice City. We followed the clues.

slides.label: EXHIBIT A: THE SUBSTATIONS
slides.title:
12 substations.
One old cheat code.
slides.body: It starts at the Key Lento radio tower: pull the power switch, turn on the TV. Then 12 substations, one letter each. Together they spell a 2002 Vice City cheat.

slides.label: EXHIBIT B: AFTER DARK
slides.title:
Reactor 2.
7 PM to 6 AM.
slides.body: 19-06 is the time window. At the power station east of Hamlet, pull the switch on the left. A portal opens.
slides.highlight: It drops you in a nightclub in a PS2-style 2002 Vice City.

slides.label: VERDICT: OPEN CASE
slides.title:
Walk out in
Tommy's shirt.
slides.body: Reported reward: Tommy Vercetti's Hawaiian shirt and a classic motorbike, and you keep both. No fast travel, no dying, or the trail resets.
slides.cta: Send this to the friend who still knows the cheats.
